mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password_hash, display_name, is_enabled, create_time, update_time FROM mcp_user WHERE id = #{id} AND is_enabled = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, password_hash, display_name, is_enabled, create_time, update_time FROM mcp_user WHERE username = #{username} AND is_enabled = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, password_hash, display_name, is_enabled, create_time, update_time FROM mcp_user ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_user (username, password_hash, display_name, is_enabled) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{isEnabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE mcp_user SET username=#{username}, display_name=#{displayName}, is_enabled=#{isEnabled} WHERE id=#{id}
